meta.name: add-codex
meta.description: Use Codex (OpenAI's codex app-server) as a full agent provider — planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, server-side history, session resume — alongside or instead of Claude. ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key, vault-only via OneCLI. Per-group via `ncl groups config update --provider codex`. Distinct from using OpenAI as an MCP tool (where Claude remains the planner).

copy.tagline: 用 Codex 替代或配合 Claude 作为智能体规划器
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Claude 之外使用 Codex 作为智能体核心规划器
copy.tagline_en: Use Codex as a full agent provider alongside or instead of Claude
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to use Codex as the primary agent planner instead of or alongside Claude

howto.what: 装上后，NanoClaw 多了 Codex 可选后端。若把某组切到 Codex，组里的规划、工具调用、MCP 工具等全由 Codex 执行，Claude 不再负责这些；记忆仍共享。
howto.when: 管理员用 `ncl groups config update --provider codex` 切换并重启组后，该组的后续对话由 Codex 接管；新建组若设了默认 `DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER=codex`，也会直接使用。

say.text: 继续我昨天的对话，聊到 React 的 Hook。
say.note: Codex 会从服务器端历史恢复上下文。

say.text: 用 MCP 工具查一下销售数据库的月度报表。
say.note: Codex 会调用已配置的 MCP 工具。

say.text: 帮我规划这个项目的发布计划，分阶段写。
say.note: Codex 会先做规划，再输出步骤。

howto.what_en: After installation, NanoClaw gains Codex as an optional agent backend. When a group is switched to Codex, planning, tool orchestration, MCP tools, etc. are all handled by Codex, while Claude no longer performs these; memory is shared.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an admin runs `ncl groups config update --provider codex` and restarts the group; or when new groups are created with `DEFAULT_AGENT_PROVIDER=codex`.

say_en.text: Continue yesterday's conversation about React Hooks.
Use an MCP tool to fetch the monthly sales report.
say_en.note: Codex invokes the configured MCP tool.

say_en.text: Plan this project's release steps by phase.
say_en.note: Codex plans first, then outputs steps.
